title: Aggregate Construction Commitment Cap and Primary-Residence Counting — Construction Loans
content:
The association caps the combined commitment of a member's Construction Loans at USD 6,000,000.00 (6000000.00 dollars) and treats a home construction loan as the member's primary residence for the occupancy rule of the Rural Home Loans.

## Policy statement

Construction commitments are aggregated across the member's construction loans in applied, active, extended or converting status: their combined commitment, including the one applied for, may not exceed USD 6,000,000.00, and a home construction loan counts as the member's primary-residence Country Home loan for the occupancy rule of the Rural Home Loans from the day it closes, so a member already holding a primary-residence Country Home loan builds a new primary residence only with a two-close loan whose permanent loan pays the old one off or re-certifies it as a second home. An application that would exceed the combined cap is not registered at the amount asked.

## Combined commitment as a quantity

The combined commitment is the total of the commitments of every Construction Loans loan of the member in applied, active, extended or converting status, together with the commitment of the application. It may equal USD 6,000,000.00; it may not exceed it.

## Cases (hypothetical commitments)

| Commitments already counted | Applied for | Combined commitment | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 4,500,000 | USD 1,500,000 | USD 6,000,000 | Does not exceed the cap |
| USD 4,500,000 | USD 1,600,000 | USD 6,100,000 | Exceeds the cap; not registered at the amount asked |
| None | USD 2,000,000 | USD 2,000,000 | Does not exceed the cap |

## Primary residence

- From the day a home construction loan closes, it counts as the member's primary-residence Country Home loan for the occupancy rule of the Rural Home Loans.
- A member who already holds a primary-residence Country Home loan builds a new primary residence only with a two-close loan whose permanent loan either pays the old Country Home loan off or re-certifies it as a second home.
